# RSA Governance & Lifecycle (G&L) Developer Portal

> The complete developer ecosystem and technical reference for RSA Governance & Lifecycle (formerly Aveksa / SecurID G&L). This documentation covers REST APIs, SaaS collectors, AFX provisioning connectors, Privileged Access Management (PAM) plugins, and core deployment architectures.

## Core Documentation Sections

- [REST API Reference](https://pradeepkg.github.io/RSA/docs/apireference/): Complete specification covering 80+ REST API endpoints, schemas, authentication mechanisms, parameters, request/response models, and error codes for programmatic lifecycle management.
- [SaaS & System Collectors](https://pradeepkg.github.io/RSA/blog/): Step-by-step guides for collecting user accounts, permissions, groups, and entitlements across 114+ cloud applications and on-premises infrastructure. Includes Okta, DocuSign, Zendesk, Salesforce, AWS, ServiceNow, Workday, and custom REST collectors.
- [AFX Provisioning Connectors](https://pradeepkg.github.io/RSA/connectors/): Configuration and deployment guides for Active Feature Framework (AFX) fulfillment connectors, automated account creation, de-provisioning, password resets, and Active Directory LDAP integration.
- [Core Concepts & Architecture](https://pradeepkg.github.io/RSA/basics/): Foundational architecture guides, Active Directory service account security models, attribute synchronization rules, custom JDBC driver installations, and JavaScript/Groovy Data Processor rules.
- [PAM Plugins](https://pradeepkg.github.io/RSA/pam/): Integration guides for connecting Privileged Access Management systems with RSA G&L.
- [Deployment Guides](https://pradeepkg.github.io/RSA/deployment/): Installation, upgrade, high availability, and containerized deployment documentation.

## Key Developer Resources

- Documentation Portal: https://pradeepkg.github.io/RSA/
